name: ascendance
description: Ascendance — a persistent massively-multiplayer strategy game. Server-authoritative, deterministic, event-driven.

scripts.build: pnpm run import && pnpm -r --filter=!@ascendance/tools run build
scripts.build:pages: pnpm run import && pnpm --filter @ascendance/shared run build && pnpm --filter @ascendance/engine run build && pnpm --filter @ascendance/client run build
scripts.ci: pnpm run import && pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
